title: Strength restoration S3 for shoulders mobility and health
summary: Short video on NH's "strength restoration S" routine for shoulder health: band pull-aparts and band shoulder dislocations done between sets, every day he does curls, and only once the shoulders are warm.

claims.claim: NH does two elastic-band movements between sets for shoulder health every day he does curls.
Band pull-aparts (overhand or underhand): straight arms, pull the shoulders back and pull the band to just below the nipples; you should feel it in the traps and mid back.
NH doesn't feel pull-aparts much in his rear delts because his big traps overpower his small delts.
Shoulder dislocations: prefer a band over a stick, keep arms straight overhead without bending the elbows, 3-5 reps.
Only do dislocations once the shoulders are already warm, and then between every set.
